name: PolicyForge API
description:
AI-assisted policy workflow API. Generate, retrieve, update, and host policy drafts programmatically, and manage consent records. Generated content is not legal advice and should be reviewed before publication.

## Authentication
Operations require a Bearer token unless they explicitly declare no security requirement. Generate an API key from your [PolicyForge API Dashboard](https://policyforge.co/api-dashboard). Keys are prefixed with `pf_live_`.

## Rate Limits
| Tier | Requests/min | Requests/day |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| Free | 10 | 100 |
| Pro | 60 | 5,000 |
| Enterprise | 300 | 50,000 |

Rate limit headers (`X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`) are included in every response.
